title: Role Isolation & LRN Display Refinement (v0.4.36)
message: Eliminates teacher leaking into student credentials roster and refines LRN display.
changelog:
🔧 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.36:
• Student Vault Role Isolation: Strictly filters student account credential rosters so educators never appear in student password tables.
• LRN Display Refinement: Removed 'LRN: Pending' label across learner credential rows, cleanly displaying only confirmed LRN identifiers.
• Role-Aware In-App Routing: Ensures educators resetting passwords automatically navigate to Teacher Dashboard regardless of initial login role toggle.
